title: Wracam bez kary
sunoPrompt: Fast gritty ska-punk with reggae-rock weight, 154 BPM, sharp offbeat guitar against driving acoustic snare, heavy mobile bass and short human gang responses. Urgent live-band charge, blunt melodic hook, rough club-room sound. Clear natural Polish diction. Build most of the song around the repeated chorus.
negativeStyle: disco, disco polo, eurodance, dance-pop, four-on-the-floor kick, schlager, synth-pop, tropical pop, glossy pop production, corporate anthem, power ballad, autotuned vocals
